Reductions (native-safe, explicit): (1) AnimatePresence enter/exit choreography is not ported - per-toast entry animation is kept but list removal is immediate. (2) react-router navigate requires an onNavigate bridge; without it 'View' dismisses with no navigation. (3) backdrop-blur and CSS grayscale have no RN equivalents and are approximated with a translucent fill and reduced opacity respectively. (4) reduced-motion preference comes from AccessibilityInfo instead of the framer-motion media query.
